learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a beautiful poem about the joy of flying high on a swing and looking at the world below!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Going up in a swing makes us feel like a happy bird flying in the bright blue sky. It is one of the most pleasant things a child can do!
When we swing very high we can look over the garden wall and see rivers trees and animals far away.

fun_activity.title: 🎡 The Swing Game
fun_activity.instructions: Visit a park with your parents safely sit on a swing and shout out three things you can see when you go up high!

quick_recap: ⭐ Swinging high in the air is a very joyful feeling.
⭐ We can see many beautiful things from up high.
⭐ Nature looks wonderful when we fly like a bird.
